fixed.summary: Moves frames: default-style games with no font use the licensed Instrument Sans variable outlines in every UI role, ahead of locale fallback faces. The cook ships no atlas and loads the separate face only when needed; games without UI documents carry no default face. A game's own font and other fonts' cook settings remain unchanged.

font-weight and font-stretch now select a role font's wght and wdth axes, including fonts supplied through UiDesc.font. Real supported bold is not synthesised; explicit @font-face descriptor ranges still constrain selection.
